claims_to_verify: 'Incline work fills in the top': incline pressing emphasises the clavicular (upper) chest — broadly supported by EMG and hypertrophy research; no single study cited on the slide.
'Dips and high-to-low flies hit the lower fibers': common coaching guidance based on fibre direction; kept as a plain statement.
'Weak triceps cut your presses short': triceps drive the lockout of presses; coaching statement.
'deep stretch at the bottom': consistent with recent research favouring training at long muscle lengths; no study cited on the slide.
Rep ranges are generic hypertrophy guidance.
